claim: Let \(P\) be the five-point \(T_0\)-space with minima \(a,b\), maxima \(x,y,z\), and all six relations \(a,b<x,y,z\). With the cycle basis \(c_1=[a,x]-[b,x]+[b,y]-[a,y]\), \(c_2=[a,x]-[b,x]+[b,z]-[a,z]\) of \(H_1(P;\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z^2\), its \(197\) continuous self-maps induce exactly \(31\) endomorphisms: the zero matrix; the \(18\) rank-one matrices \(\pm u v^{\mathsf T}\) with \(u\in\{(1,0)^{\mathsf T},(0,1)^{\mathsf T},(1,-1)^{\mathsf T}\}\) and \(v\in\{(1,0)^{\mathsf T},(0,1)^{\mathsf T},(1,1)^{\mathsf T}\}\); and the \(12\) integral isometries of \(q(s,t)=s^2+st+t^2\). Exactly \(12\) self-maps induce an isomorphism on \(H_1\), and these are precisely the \(12\) homeomorphisms.

integrity.claim_scope: continuous self-maps of the five-point height-two \(K_{2,3}\) finite model and their induced integral first-homology actions
integrity.novelty_boundary: the five-point minimal model and finite-space/order-complex correspondence are prior work; the exact 197-map census, 31-element homology image, rank-one factorization, hexagonal isometry description, and homology-isomorphism rigidity are the claimed new content
integrity.proof_core: complete order-preserving-map enumeration plus an explicit order-complex cycle-basis calculation and structural matrix-set check

scientific_limitations: The statement concerns direct self-maps of one specified five-point minimal finite model of \(S^1\vee S^1\), not arbitrary larger finite models or subdivisions.
The exact realization semigroup is established by a complete finite enumeration over all 3125 set maps, with a replayable dependency-free verifier.
Targeted literature and published-findings searches cannot exclude every obscure or unindexed prior enumeration.
title: Homology-action rigidity of the five-point \(S^1\vee S^1\) model
